title: One GitHub transport: devcase repo reads say unreadable, never no-history
deviations_from_card: githubRead lives in app/_lib/repo-snapshot.ts (the leaf), not client.ts: client.ts imports and re-exports it and githubFetch wraps it. Hosting it in client.ts made every devcase/task-hub route import client.ts + github-evidence.ts (+2 modules, +29 KB on ~25 routes, several already at the module ceiling); in the leaf it is 0 modules / +9 KB there. Write set otherwise as carded, plus the allowed doc-map entry, a new colocated app/_lib/devcase-run-unreadable.test.ts (tests of a write-set module), and perf-budget.json (shared surface, only this card's share). The 404 path stays null and GitHub's 409 empty-repo answer on the commits list also stays null (a fact about the repo). A non-array 200 on the list is unreadable 'bad_shape'.
notes: Acceptance 8 of 8 (was 0 of 8); 29 node:test cases across 4 files, 27 red before. The fairness pin: scoreAuthenticity({commitCount:5, decisionsLogPresent:null}) scores exactly the same as a read tree with the log and emits decisionsLogUnread; a throttled commits list makes runEvaluateSubmission throw RepoUnreadableError (code REPO_UNREADABLE, retryable, retryAfterSec) with no evaluation saved. The task hub only records error.message (per the critic, no task-level retry class is claimed). Known follow-ups, outside the write set: (1) DevEvalPanelProcessTrace.tsx still renders decisionsLogPresent null as 'missing' in coral (the authenticity tooltip says unread); DevTypes.ts types it boolean. (2) The Python evaluator still receives topLevel [] for an unread tree (repo.json carries no readability flag). (3) useDevSubmissionRow.ts value-imports parseRepoRef from repo-snapshot.ts, so app/page.tsx gained offline.ts + request-body.ts (+2 modules / +21 KB, budget raised); moving parseRepoRef into its own leaf gives them back. tsc: exit 1 only on the untracked kpi-sim/ tree (foreign); zero errors in app/. test:perf: still red only on lines that are red at base with sibling uncommitted work (analyze, redraft, devcase/control, approve, intake promote, retry-analysis, interview-kit, status letter, tasks retry, page, job-ingest) - measured with this card's four source files swapped to base, the same lines are over; this card's share (+9 KB routes, +2/+21 page) was raised in 00fe6331e. Full test:unit 9992/9992 green on the final run (an earlier run's two BROKEN files, python-runner-concurrency and api/tasks/route.test.ts, were sibling in-flight files and green on re-run).
